name: Micro Dose
description:
Run a fictional underworld business, one night at a time. Set your price, quantity, quality and distribution, then see what the night brings. Buy districts and fronts as your cash and credibility grow. Keep an eye on the heat: 100 ends your run.

Up and Down browse your plan; Select opens a setting to edit. This watch edition keeps the calculator-era economy, districts and fronts. Crew and rival systems belong to the larger game.

For Pebble Time 2 and Pebble Round 2. Touch controls require firmware 4.33.2 or later. Every action also works with buttons.

By Luke Steuber.
gifStyle: Sequence of unchanged native gameplay captures, 1300 ms per frame
releaseNotes: The dashboard now has a city skyline, a larger cash display, and labeled credibility and heat meters. An outline and accent mark the setting you have selected.
